body: Soap, gloves, and two water jugs, paid cash. On the back: “Trial crew used the sink at dawn. My eyes burned before the road was shut.”
title: Soap bought after the field run
gloss: A personal trace places field-program residue before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have encountered the same residue while responding; the personal trace does not by itself prove the field program caused the emergency.

body:
The shelves were emptied twice. The first group took food; the second stepped over the broken glass to ask for the delivery ledger.

I showed them the register because I had no ledger left. They wanted the names of people who had bought anything that morning. I could still recall one woman because her son carried the bag.

They wrote her down and told me not to mention their visit. I keep hearing the boy ask whether he could have the receipt.
title: The inventory they took
gloss: A scene-specific count or record was controlled while people were still present.
rival_reading: The same trace could follow an investigation of contaminated farm goods or an ordinary emergency response.
